finalText:
Build clean, exit 0.

Two real bugs, both from bundler options-shape change:
- `src/core/options.js` — read `options.retries` (undefined after bump), now reads `options.retryCount`. Threw on `.toFixed`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — strict boolean check threw on `undefined` flag. Now treats anything not `true` as disabled (matches old `false`-default behavior).

Rest of warnings: deprecation noise from the dep bump (DEP0142/0198/0233/0250/0267 etc), harmless.
